title: Synthesis of Novel Azetidinone and Thiazolidinones Derivatives and Evaluation of Their Antimicrobial Efficacy
abstract: 2‐Amino‐4‐(2‐naphthalenyl) thiazole (                     1                     ) was prepared from 2‐acetylnapthalene. This amine on facile condensation with aromatic aldehydes afford Schiff Base/anils/azomethines(                     2a-h                     ). These anils on cyclocondensation reaction with chloro acetyl chloride and thio glycolic acid (                     i.e                     . mercapto acetic acid) yields 2‐azetidinones and 4‐thiazolidinones respectively. The prepared compounds have been screened on some stains of bacteria.
